measure_name: R1 P02 Cohort Funded Account Paths
expression:
VAR _EndpointDate =
            [R1 P01 Evidence Max Date]
        RETURN
            CALCULATE (
                [R1 P01 Funded Account Paths],
                REMOVEFILTERS ( 'DimAsOfDate' ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _EndpointDate },
                    'DimAsOfDate'[AsOfDate]
                )
            )

VAR _EndpointDate =
            [R1 P01 Evidence Max Date]
        RETURN
            CALCULATE (
                [R1 P01 Funded Amount],
                REMOVEFILTERS ( 'DimAsOfDate' ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _EndpointDate },
                    'DimAsOfDate'[AsOfDate]
                )
            )

DIVIDE (
            [R1 P02 Cohort Funded Amount],
            [R1 P02 Cohort Funded Account Paths]

measure_name: R1 P02 __First Paid-Off Day As Of
expression:
VAR _AsOfDate =
            [Selected As Of Date]
        RETURN
            IF (
                [R1 P01 As Of Evidence Status] = "VALID",
                CALCULATE (
                    MIN (
                        'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_day_index]
                    ),
                    FILTER (
                        ALL ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_date] ),
                        'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_date] <= _AsOfDate
                    ),
                    'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[paid_off_flag] = "t"
                )
            )

measure_name: R1 P02 Active Account Paths As Of
expression:
IF (
            [R1 P01 As Of Evidence Status] = "VALID",
            COALESCE (
                SUMX (
                    VALUES (
                        'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    ),
                    VAR _LatestDate =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P01 __Latest Monitoring Date As Of]
                        )
                    VAR _Exposure =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P01 __Exposure As Of]
                        )
                    VAR _PaidOffFlag =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P02 __Paid-Off Flag As Of]
                        )
                    RETURN
                        IF (
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _LatestDate )
                                && COALESCE ( _Exposure, 0 ) > 0
                                && _PaidOffFlag <> "t",
                            1,
                            0
                        )
                ),
                0
            )
        )

measure_name: R1 P02 Attention Account Paths As Of
expression:
IF (
            [R1 P01 As Of Evidence Status] = "VALID",
            COALESCE (
                SUMX (
                    VALUES (
                        'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    ),
                    VAR _LatestDate =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P01 __Latest Monitoring Date As Of]
                        )
                    VAR _MonitoringStatus =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P02 __Monitoring Status As Of]
                        )
                    VAR _PaidOffFlag =
                        CALCULATE (
                            [R1 P02 __Paid-Off Flag As Of]
                        )
                    RETURN
                        IF (
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _LatestDate )
                                && _PaidOffFlag <> "t"
                                && _MonitoringStatus
                                    IN {
                                        "WATCH",
                                        "UNDERPERFORMING",
                                        "SEVERE_SHORTFALL",
                                        "DORMANT_NO_REMITTANCE"
                                    },
                            1,
                            0
                        )
                ),
                0
            )
        )

VAR _LatestDate =
            [R1 P01 __Latest Monitoring Date As Of]
        VAR _HorizonDays =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[selected_horizon_days]
            )
        VAR _PaidOffFlag =
            [R1 P02 __Paid-Off Flag As Of]
        VAR _FirstPaidOffDay =
            [R1 P02 __First Paid-Off Day As Of]
        VAR _CurrentMonitoringDay =
            [R1 P02 __Monitoring Day Index As Of]
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _LatestDate )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _HorizonDays ),
                IF (
                    _PaidOffFlag = "t"
                        && NOT ISBLANK ( _FirstPaidOffDay ),
                    _FirstPaidOffDay - _HorizonDays,
                    MAX (
                        0,
                        _CurrentMonitoringDay - _HorizonDays
                    )
                )
            )

VAR _Outcome =
            COALESCE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_final_outcome_code]
                ),
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1DimApplicationScenario'[governed_final_outcome_code]
                )
            )
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                _Outcome,
                "APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED_AUTHORIZED", "Approved as requested",
                "COUNTEROFFER_AUTHORIZED", "Counteroffer authorized",
                "COUNTEROFFER_REVIEW_REQUIRED", "Counteroffer review",
                "MANUAL_UNDERWRITING_REVIEW_REQUIRED", "Underwriting review",
                "DECLINE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", "Evidence decline",
                "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE", "No feasible structure",
                "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP", "Policy hard stop",
                BLANK ()
            )

SWITCH (
            [R26 P03 Decision Class],
            "AUTHORIZED", "#2E7D32",
            "REVIEW",     "#C58A00",
            "DECLINED",   "#C62828",
            "#667085"
        )

VAR _Frontier =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selection_frontier]
            )
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                _Frontier,
                "STRICT_AUTOMATIC_FRONT", "Automatic frontier",
                "REVIEW_ELIGIBLE_FRONT",  "Review frontier",
                "BASELINE_ROUTE_FLOOR",    "Baseline route floor",
                "NO_STRUCTURE",            "No structure",
                _Frontier
            )

VAR _Required =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[search_required_flag]
            )
        VAR _Attempted =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[search_attempted_flag]
            )
        VAR _Complete =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[search_complete_flag]
            )
        VAR _Count =
            [R26 P03 Candidates Evaluated]
        VAR _Frontier =
            [R26 P03 Selection Frontier]
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _Required ), BLANK (),
                _Required = FALSE (), "Search: not required",
                _Attempted = FALSE (), "Search: required • not attempted",
                _Complete = FALSE (),
                    "Search: "
                        & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _Count, 0 ), "0" )
                        & " evaluated • incomplete",
                "Search: "
                    & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _Count, 0 ), "0" )
                    & " evaluated"
                    & IF (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _Frontier ),
                        " • " & _Frontier,
                        ""
                    )
            )

VAR _ApplicationScenarioKey =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )

            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _ApplicationScenarioKey ),
                CALCULATE (
                    COUNTROWS ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring' ),
                    REMOVEFILTERS (
                        'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_date]
                    ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _ApplicationScenarioKey },
                        'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _ApplicationScenarioKey ),
                BLANK (),
                IF ( COALESCE ( _MonitoringRows, 0 ) > 0, 1, 0 )
            )

IF (
            [R26 P03 Funded Lifecycle Available] = 1,
            "Funded synthetic account • deterministic synthetic-forward",
            "No funded-account lifecycle for this application-scenario"

IF (
            [R26 P03 Funded Lifecycle Available] = 1,
            "Governed monitoring status across the funded-account lifecycle",
            "No funded-account monitoring path for this application-scenario"
        )

            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_status_code]
            )
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                _Status,
                "PAID_OFF",              0,
                "CURRENT",               1,
                "WATCH",                 2,
                "UNDERPERFORMING",       3,
                "SEVERE_SHORTFALL",      4,
                "DORMANT_NO_REMITTANCE", 5,

            )

            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_status_code]
            )
        RETURN

                "PAID_OFF",              "Paid off",
                "CURRENT",               "Current",
                "WATCH",                 "Watch",
                "UNDERPERFORMING",       "Underperforming",
                "SEVERE_SHORTFALL",      "Severe shortfall",
                "DORMANT_NO_REMITTANCE", "Dormant / no remittance",
                BLANK ()

measure_name: R26 P03 Selected Structure Alt Text
expression:
VAR _Amount =
            [R26 P03 Selected Structure Amount]
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _Amount ),
                "No governed selected structure is present for the selected application and scenario.",
                "Governed selected structure. Selected amount "
                    & FORMAT ( _Amount, "$#,0.00" )
                    & ", remittance rate "
                    & FORMAT (
                        [R26 P03 Selected Remittance Rate],
                        "0.00%"
                    )
                    & ", payback multiple "
                    & FORMAT (
                        [R26 P03 Selected Payback Multiple],
                        "0.00"
                    )
                    & ", horizon "
                    & FORMAT (
                        [R26 P03 Selected Horizon Days],
                        "0"
                    )
                    & " days, total repayment "
                    & FORMAT (
                        [R26 P03 Selected Total Repayment],
                        "$#,0.00"
                    )
                    & "."
            )

IF (
            [R26 P03 Funded Lifecycle Available] <> 1,
            "No funded-account servicing or intervention evidence is available for this application-scenario path.",
            "Servicing and intervention. Intervention: "
                & COALESCE (
                    [R26 P03 Intervention Display],
                    "not available"
                )
                & ". Action: "
                & COALESCE (
                    [R26 P03 Servicing Action Display],
                    "not available"
                )
                & ". Queue: "
                & COALESCE (
                    [R26 P03 Servicing Queue Display],
                    "not available"
                )
                & ". Exposure: "
                & FORMAT (
                    COALESCE (
                        [R26 P03 Intervention Exposure],
                        0
                    ),
                    "$#,0.00"
                )
                & ". Reason: "
                & COALESCE (
                    [R26 P03 Intervention Reason Display],
                    "not available"
                )
                & "."
        )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _Rows =
            CALCULATE (
                COUNTROWS (
                    'R1FactFundedLifecycle'
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _Key )
                    && _Rows = 1,
                1,
                0
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                [R26 P03 Funded Lifecycle Available] = 1
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                CALCULATE (
                    SELECTEDVALUE (
                        'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[funding_date]
                    ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _LifecycleRows =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                CALCULATE (
                    COUNTROWS ( 'R1FactFundedLifecycle' ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                _LifecycleRows = 1,
                CALCULATE (
                    SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[funding_date] ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFundedLifecycle'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _UsableDays =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                CALCULATE (
                    MAX ( 'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[usable_pos_days] ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )
        VAR _RequiredDays =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                CALCULATE (
                    MAX ( 'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[required_usable_days] ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )
        VAR _OutageDays =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                CALCULATE (
                    MAX ( 'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[disconnected_outage_days] ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _Key },
                        'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                    )
                )
            )
        VAR _PrimaryReason =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[primary_unavailability_reason_code]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _FirstReason =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[first_nondecisionable_reason_code]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFeatureAvailability'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _ReasonCodes =
            _PrimaryReason & "|" & _FirstReason
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                    BLANK (),
                NOT ISBLANK ( _UsableDays )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequiredDays )
                    && _UsableDays < _RequiredDays,
                    "the governed 30-day sales window contained "
                        & FORMAT ( _UsableDays, "0" )
                        & " usable days versus "
                        & FORMAT ( _RequiredDays, "0" )
                        & " required"
                        & IF (
                            COALESCE ( _OutageDays, 0 ) > 0,
                            ", including "
                                & FORMAT ( _OutageDays, "0" )
                                & IF (
                                    _OutageDays = 1,
                                    " disconnected processor-outage day",
                                    " disconnected processor-outage days"
                                ),
                            ""
                        ),
                CONTAINSSTRING (
                    _ReasonCodes,
                    "PROCESSOR_CONTINUITY_DISRUPTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE"
                ),
                    "processor continuity was disrupted, limiting the reliability of the recent operating window",
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _ReasonCodes, "SPECIFIC_VERIFICATION_OR_CONFLICT" ),
                    "a specific verification conflict remained unresolved",
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _ReasonCodes, "MEDIUM_DATA_CONFIDENCE" ),
                    "the available evidence did not meet the confidence standard for a fully reliable assessment",
                "required operating evidence was incomplete or contradictory"
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _HumanCodes =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[human_review_reason_codes]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _BindingCodes =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_binding_policy_reason_codes]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _CandidateReviewCodes =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_candidate_review_reason_codes]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _Codes =
            _HumanCodes & "|" & _BindingCodes & "|" & _CandidateReviewCodes
        VAR _HasVerification =
            CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "SPECIFIC_VERIFICATION_OR_CONFLICT" )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "FRAUD_TIER_3" )
        VAR _HasCapacity =
            CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "CAPACITY_REVIEW_FRONTIER" )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "R1_CAPACITY_COMPOSITE" )
        VAR _HasRepayment =
            CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "TOTAL_REPAYMENT_REVIEW_ONLY" )
                || CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "R1_TOTAL_REPAYMENT_GUARDRAIL" )
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                    BLANK (),
                _HasVerification && _HasCapacity,
                    "a verification concern requires specialist resolution and the proposed structure sits near the approved capacity boundary",
                _HasVerification,
                    "a verification concern requires specialist resolution",
                CONTAINSSTRING (
                    _Codes,
                    "PROCESSOR_CONTINUITY_DISRUPTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE"
                ),
                    "disrupted processor continuity limits confidence in the recent operating evidence",
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "MEDIUM_DATA_CONFIDENCE" ),
                    "the evidence is usable but not strong enough for straight-through authorization",
                _HasRepayment && _HasCapacity,
                    "the proposed structure sits near the capacity boundary and the repayment obligation remains within the permitted review band rather than the automatic-authorization band",
                _HasRepayment,
                    "the repayment obligation remains within the permitted review band rather than the automatic-authorization band",
                _HasCapacity,
                    "the proposed structure sits near the approved capacity boundary",
                "expert judgment is required to resolve the remaining review condition"
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _HumanCodes =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[human_review_reason_codes]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _BindingCodes =
            UPPER (
                COALESCE (
                    CALCULATE (
                        SELECTEDVALUE (
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_binding_policy_reason_codes]
                        ),
                        TREATAS (
                            { _Key },
                            'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                        )
                    ),
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _Codes =
            _HumanCodes & "|" & _BindingCodes
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                    BLANK (),
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "FRAUD_TIER_3" ),
                    "an elevated verification or fraud-risk condition that could not be cured by changing the deal terms",
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "SPECIFIC_VERIFICATION_OR_CONFLICT" ),
                    "a non-remediable verification conflict",
                CONTAINSSTRING (
                    _Codes,
                    "PROCESSOR_CONTINUITY_DISRUPTED_OR_UNAVAILABLE"
                ),
                    "a required processor-continuity condition",
                CONTAINSSTRING ( _Codes, "MEDIUM_DATA_CONFIDENCE" ),
                    "an evidence-confidence condition that fell outside the permitted policy boundary",
                "a non-remediable policy, verification, or covenant condition"
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _Scenario =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[scenario_code]
            )
        VAR _FloorApplied =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[stress_floor_applied_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _OutcomeChanged =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[outcome_changed_by_floor_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _CandidateChanged =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[candidate_changed_by_floor_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        RETURN
            IF (
                _Scenario = "RECESSION_ENERGY"
                    && _FloorApplied = TRUE ()
                    && (
                        _OutcomeChanged = TRUE ()
                            || _CandidateChanged = TRUE ()
                    ),
                " Under the stress scenario, the governed path was held no more favorable than the matched Baseline path, preventing stressed assumptions from producing an artificially better result.",
                ""
            )

expression:

                _RelationshipCode,
                "NEW", "new",
                "LOW_AND_GROW", "developing",

                "RETURNING_MIXED", "returning with mixed prior performance",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _RelationshipCode, "selected" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _SizeLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _SizeCode,
                "MICRO", "micro-business",
                "SMALL", "small-business",
                "LOWER_MIDDLE", "lower-middle-market",
                "MIDDLE", "middle-market",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _SizeCode, "selected" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _IndustryLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _IndustryCode,
                "CONSTRUCTION_TRADES", "construction and skilled-trades",
                "ECOMMERCE_DIGITAL", "e-commerce and digital",
                "ENERGY_SERVICES", "energy-services",
                "GENERAL_RETAIL", "general-retail",
                "HEALTHCARE_SERVICES", "healthcare-services",
                "PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES", "professional-services",
                "RESTAURANT_FOOD_SERVICE", "restaurant and food-service",
                "TRANSPORTATION_LOGISTICS", "transportation and logistics",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _IndustryCode, "selected-industry" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _ChannelLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _ChannelCode,
                "BROKER_NETWORK", "the broker network",
                "BANK_RELATIONSHIP", "the bank-relationship channel",
                "DIGITAL_DIRECT", "the digital-direct channel",
                "PROCESSOR_DIRECT", "the processor-direct channel",
                "STRATEGIC_PARTNER", "a strategic partner",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _ChannelCode, "the selected channel" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _AnnualizedSales =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[annualized_eligible_sales]
            )

            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[average_available_balance_30d]
            )

            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[negative_balance_day_rate_30d]
            )
        VAR _NsfCount =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[nsf_count_30d]
            )
        VAR _ContextSentence =
            "This is a "
                & _RelationshipLabel
                & " "
                & _SizeLabel
                & " "
                & _IndustryLabel
                & " merchant sourced through "
                & _ChannelLabel
                & "."
        VAR _CoreMetricsSentence =
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                NOT ISBLANK ( _AnnualizedSales )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _AverageLiquidity ),
                    " Recent decision-time evidence showed approximately "
                        & FORMAT ( _AnnualizedSales, "$#,0" )
                        & " in annualized eligible sales and "
                        & FORMAT ( _AverageLiquidity, "$#,0" )
                        & " in average available liquidity.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _AnnualizedSales ),
                    " Recent decision-time evidence showed approximately "
                        & FORMAT ( _AnnualizedSales, "$#,0" )
                        & " in annualized eligible sales.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _AverageLiquidity ),
                    " Recent decision-time evidence showed approximately "
                        & FORMAT ( _AverageLiquidity, "$#,0" )
                        & " in average available liquidity.",
                " Decision-critical operating evidence was available for assessment."
            )
        VAR _BehaviorSentence =
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NsfCount = 0
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate = 0,
                    " No NSF events or negative-balance days were observed in the governed 30-day window.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate ),
                    " The same window included "
                        & FORMAT ( _NsfCount, "0" )
                        & IF ( _NsfCount = 1, " NSF event", " NSF events" )
                        & " and negative balances on "
                        & FORMAT ( _NegativeBalanceRate, "0.0%" )
                        & " of observed days; those conditions were carried into the assessment.",
                ""
            )
        VAR _EvidenceIssue =
            [R26 P03 __Evidence Issue Plain English]
        VAR _HardStop =
            [R26 P03 __Hard Stop Plain English]
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                BLANK (),
                SWITCH (
                    TRUE (),
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                        _ContextSentence
                            & " The merchant profile was available, but "
                            & _EvidenceIssue
                            & ". Because that gap prevented a reliable capacity and risk assessment, the platform stopped rather than treating missing evidence as weak performance.",

                        _ContextSentence
                            & _CoreMetricsSentence

                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 1,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedAmount )

                        "Phrase",
                            "changed the amount from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestAmount, "$#,0" )
                                & " to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedAmount, "$#,0" )
                    ),
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 2,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedRemittance )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestRemittance )
                                && ABS ( _SelectedRemittance - _RequestRemittance ) >= 0.000001,
                        "Phrase",
                            "adjusted the remittance rate from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestRemittance, "0.00%" )
                                & " to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedRemittance, "0.00%" )
                    ),
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 3,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedPayback )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestPayback )
                                && ABS ( _SelectedPayback - _RequestPayback ) >= 0.000001,

                                & FORMAT ( _RequestPayback, "0.00" )
                                & "x to "

                                & " to "

                        & " "
                        & _IndustryLabel

                        & _ChannelLabel
                        & ".",

                        & " "

                    && _NegativeBalanceRate > 0,
                    " The same window included "
                        & FORMAT ( _NsfCount, "0" )
                        & IF ( _NsfCount = 1, " NSF event", " NSF events" )
                        & ", and balances were negative on "
                        & FORMAT ( _NegativeBalanceRate, "0.0%" )
                        & " of observed days. These conditions were incorporated into the assessment.",

                    " No NSF events were observed in the governed 30-day window.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )

                    " No negative-balance days were observed in the governed 30-day window.",

                    " Balances were negative on "

                        & " of observed days. That behavior was incorporated into the assessment.",

            [R26 P03 __Evidence Issue Plain English]
        VAR _HardStop =

                        _ContextSentence

                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP",
                        _ContextSentence

                            & _HardStop

                    _ContextSentence
                        & _CoreMetricsSentence

            )

                            & " A reliable structure assessment could not be completed because "
                            & _EvidenceIssue
                            & ". This is an evidence-based stop, not a conclusion that every possible structure would fail.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE"
                        && _StressFloorApplied = TRUE ()
                        && _OutcomeChangedByFloor = TRUE (),
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The independent stress path did not support a more favorable result, and the governed outcome was held to the matched Baseline no-feasible-structure route under the approved non-improvement floor.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE",

                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP",

            )

                "NEW", "new",
                "LOW_AND_GROW", "developing",
                "RETURNING_GOOD", "returning with strong prior performance",
                "RETURNING_MIXED", "returning with mixed prior performance",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _RelationshipCode, "selected" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _SizeLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _SizeCode,
                "MICRO", "micro-business",
                "SMALL", "small-business",
                "LOWER_MIDDLE", "lower-middle-market",
                "MIDDLE", "middle-market",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _SizeCode, "selected" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _IndustryLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _IndustryCode,
                "CONSTRUCTION_TRADES", "construction and skilled-trades",
                "ECOMMERCE_DIGITAL", "e-commerce and digital",
                "ENERGY_SERVICES", "energy-services",
                "GENERAL_RETAIL", "general-retail",
                "HEALTHCARE_SERVICES", "healthcare-services",
                "PROFESSIONAL_SERVICES", "professional-services",
                "RESTAURANT_FOOD_SERVICE", "restaurant and food-service",
                "TRANSPORTATION_LOGISTICS", "transportation and logistics",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _IndustryCode, "selected-industry" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _ChannelLabel =
            SWITCH (
                _ChannelCode,
                "BROKER_NETWORK", "the broker network",
                "BANK_RELATIONSHIP", "the bank-relationship channel",
                "DIGITAL_DIRECT", "the digital-direct channel",
                "PROCESSOR_DIRECT", "the processor-direct channel",
                "STRATEGIC_PARTNER", "a strategic partner",
                LOWER ( SUBSTITUTE ( COALESCE ( _ChannelCode, "the selected channel" ), "_", " " ) )
            )
        VAR _AnnualizedSales =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[annualized_eligible_sales]
            )
        VAR _AverageLiquidity =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[average_available_balance_30d]
            )
        VAR _NegativeBalanceRate =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[negative_balance_day_rate_30d]
            )
        VAR _NsfCount =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[nsf_count_30d]
            )
        VAR _ContextSentence =
            SWITCH (
                _RelationshipCode,
                "NEW",
                    "This is a new "
                        & _SizeLabel
                        & " "
                        & _IndustryLabel
                        & " merchant sourced through "
                        & _ChannelLabel
                        & ".",
                "LOW_AND_GROW",
                    "This is a developing "
                        & _SizeLabel
                        & " "
                        & _IndustryLabel
                        & " merchant sourced through "
                        & _ChannelLabel
                        & ".",
                "RETURNING_GOOD",
                    "This is a returning "
                        & _SizeLabel
                        & " "
                        & _IndustryLabel
                        & " merchant with strong prior performance, sourced through "
                        & _ChannelLabel
                        & ".",
                "RETURNING_MIXED",
                    "This is a returning "
                        & _SizeLabel
                        & " "
                        & _IndustryLabel
                        & " merchant with mixed prior performance, sourced through "
                        & _ChannelLabel
                        & ".",
                "This is a "
                    & _SizeLabel
                    & " "
                    & _IndustryLabel
                    & " merchant sourced through "
                    & _ChannelLabel
                    & ". The relationship profile is "
                    & _RelationshipLabel
                    & "."
            )
        VAR _LiquiditySentence =
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _AverageLiquidity ),
                    "",
                _AverageLiquidity < 0,
                    " Average available liquidity was negative at "
                        & FORMAT ( ABS ( _AverageLiquidity ), "$#,0" )
                        & ".",
                _AverageLiquidity = 0,
                    " Average available liquidity was approximately $0.",
                " Average available liquidity was approximately "
                    & FORMAT ( _AverageLiquidity, "$#,0" )
                    & "."
            )
        VAR _CoreMetricsSentence =
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                NOT ISBLANK ( _AnnualizedSales ),
                    " Recent decision-time evidence showed approximately "
                        & FORMAT ( _AnnualizedSales, "$#,0" )
                        & " in annualized eligible sales."
                        & _LiquiditySentence,
                NOT ISBLANK ( _AverageLiquidity ),
                    _LiquiditySentence,
                " Decision-critical operating evidence was available for assessment."
            )
        VAR _BehaviorSentence =
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate ),
                    "",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NsfCount = 0
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate = 0,
                    " No NSF events or negative-balance days were observed in the governed 30-day window.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NsfCount = 0
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate > 0,
                    " No NSF events were observed, although balances were negative on "
                        & FORMAT ( _NegativeBalanceRate, "0.0%" )
                        & " of observed days. These conditions were incorporated into the assessment.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NsfCount > 0
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate = 0,
                    " The same window included "
                        & FORMAT ( _NsfCount, "0" )
                        & IF ( _NsfCount = 1, " NSF event", " NSF events" )
                        & ", but no negative-balance days were observed. These conditions were incorporated into the assessment.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NsfCount > 0
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate > 0,
                    " The same window included "
                        & FORMAT ( _NsfCount, "0" )
                        & IF ( _NsfCount = 1, " NSF event", " NSF events" )
                        & ", and balances were negative on "
                        & FORMAT ( _NegativeBalanceRate, "0.0%" )
                        & " of observed days. These conditions were incorporated into the assessment.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && _NsfCount = 0,
                    " No NSF events were observed in the governed 30-day window.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NsfCount )
                    && _NsfCount > 0,
                    " The governed 30-day window included "
                        & FORMAT ( _NsfCount, "0" )
                        & IF ( _NsfCount = 1, " NSF event", " NSF events" )
                        & ". That behavior was incorporated into the assessment.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate = 0,
                    " No negative-balance days were observed in the governed 30-day window.",
                NOT ISBLANK ( _NegativeBalanceRate )
                    && _NegativeBalanceRate > 0,
                    " Balances were negative on "
                        & FORMAT ( _NegativeBalanceRate, "0.0%" )
                        & " of observed days. That behavior was incorporated into the assessment.",
                ""
            )
        VAR _EvidenceIssue =
            [R26 P03 __Evidence Issue Plain English]
        VAR _HardStop =
            [R26 P03 __Hard Stop Plain English]
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                BLANK (),
                SWITCH (
                    TRUE (),
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                        _ContextSentence
                            & " The merchant profile was available, but "
                            & _EvidenceIssue
                            & ". Because that gap prevented a reliable capacity and risk assessment, the platform stopped rather than treating missing evidence as weak performance.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP",
                        _ContextSentence
                            & _CoreMetricsSentence
                            & " The evidence also identified "
                            & _HardStop
                            & ", which was preserved as a hard stop rather than diluted into a weaker risk score.",
                    _ContextSentence
                        & _CoreMetricsSentence
                        & _BehaviorSentence
                )
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _Outcome =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_final_outcome_code]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _RequestAmount =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[requested_amount]
            )
        VAR _RequestRemittance =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[requested_remittance_rate]
            )
        VAR _RequestPayback =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[requested_payback_multiple]
            )
        VAR _RequestHorizon =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[requested_horizon_days]
            )
        VAR _RequestRepayment =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[requested_total_repayment_amount]
            )
        VAR _SearchAttempted =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[search_attempted_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _SearchComplete =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[search_complete_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _EvaluatedCount =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[evaluated_candidate_count]
            )
        VAR _SelectedAmount =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_funding_amount]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _SelectedRemittance =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_remittance_rate]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _SelectedPayback =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_payback_multiple]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _SelectedHorizon =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_horizon_days]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _SelectedRepayment =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_total_repayment_amount]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _Coverage =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_payment_coverage_ratio]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _Liquidity =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_post_financing_liquidity]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _LossRate =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_comparative_loss_rate]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _Contribution =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_risk_adjusted_contribution]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _StressFloorApplied =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[stress_floor_applied_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _OutcomeChangedByFloor =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[outcome_changed_by_floor_flag]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _RequestSentence =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestAmount ),
                "The merchant requested "
                    & FORMAT ( _RequestAmount, "$#,0" )
                    & " at a "
                    & FORMAT ( _RequestRemittance, "0.00%" )
                    & " remittance rate, "
                    & FORMAT ( _RequestPayback, "0.00" )
                    & "x payback and a "
                    & FORMAT ( _RequestHorizon, "0" )
                    & "-day horizon, for "
                    & FORMAT ( _RequestRepayment, "$#,0" )
                    & " in total repayment.",
                "The selected application did not expose complete request terms."
            )
        VAR _ChangeRows =
            FILTER (
                UNION (
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 1,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedAmount )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestAmount )
                                && ABS ( _SelectedAmount - _RequestAmount ) >= 0.01,
                        "Phrase",
                            "changed the amount from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestAmount, "$#,0" )
                                & " to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedAmount, "$#,0" )
                    ),
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 2,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedRemittance )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestRemittance )
                                && ABS ( _SelectedRemittance - _RequestRemittance ) >= 0.000001,
                        "Phrase",
                            "adjusted the remittance rate from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestRemittance, "0.00%" )
                                & " to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedRemittance, "0.00%" )
                    ),
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 3,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedPayback )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestPayback )
                                && ABS ( _SelectedPayback - _RequestPayback ) >= 0.000001,
                        "Phrase",
                            "adjusted payback from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestPayback, "0.00" )
                                & "x to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedPayback, "0.00" )
                                & "x"
                    ),
                    ROW (
                        "Seq", 4,
                        "Hit",
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedHorizon )
                                && NOT ISBLANK ( _RequestHorizon )
                                && _SelectedHorizon <> _RequestHorizon,
                        "Phrase",
                            "changed the horizon from "
                                & FORMAT ( _RequestHorizon, "0" )
                                & " to "
                                & FORMAT ( _SelectedHorizon, "0" )
                                & " days"
                    )
                ),
                [Hit] = TRUE ()
            )
        VAR _ChangeText =
            CONCATENATEX (
                _ChangeRows,
                [Phrase],
                "; ",
                [Seq],
                ASC
            )
        VAR _ChangeSentence =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _ChangeText ),
                " The selected alternative " & _ChangeText & ".",
                IF (
                    NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedAmount ),
                    " The selected alternative retained the principal requested terms while applying the governed candidate-selection rules.",
                    ""
                )
            )
        VAR _MetricsLead =
            IF (
                _Outcome
                    IN {
                        "COUNTEROFFER_REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                        "MANUAL_UNDERWRITING_REVIEW_REQUIRED"
                    },
                " The review-eligible terms",
                " The selected terms"
            )
        VAR _MetricsSentence =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _SelectedAmount )
                    && (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _Coverage )
                            || NOT ISBLANK ( _Liquidity )
                            || NOT ISBLANK ( _LossRate )
                            || NOT ISBLANK ( _Contribution )
                    ),
                _MetricsLead
                    & IF (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _Coverage ),
                        " provide " & FORMAT ( _Coverage, "0.00" ) & "x payment coverage",
                        ""
                    )
                    & IF (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _Liquidity ),
                        IF (
                            _Liquidity < 0,
                            IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _Coverage ), ", with ", " show " )
                                & "modeled post-financing liquidity negative at "
                                & FORMAT ( ABS ( _Liquidity ), "$#,0" ),
                            IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _Coverage ), ", retain ", " retain " )
                                & "approximately "
                                & FORMAT ( _Liquidity, "$#,0" )
                                & " in modeled post-financing liquidity"
                        ),
                        ""
                    )
                    & IF (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _Contribution ),
                        IF (
                            NOT ISBLANK ( _Coverage )
                                || NOT ISBLANK ( _Liquidity ),
                            ", and produce ",
                            " produce "
                        )
                            & FORMAT ( _Contribution, "$#,0" )
                            & " in risk-adjusted contribution",
                        ""
                    )
                    & IF (
                        NOT ISBLANK ( _LossRate ),
                        " at a "
                            & FORMAT ( _LossRate, "0.0%" )
                            & " comparative expected-loss rate",
                        ""
                    )
                    & ".",
                ""
            )
        VAR _EvidenceIssue =
            [R26 P03 __Evidence Issue Plain English]
        VAR _ReviewReason =
            [R26 P03 __Review Reason Plain English]
        VAR _HardStop =
            [R26 P03 __Hard Stop Plain English]
        VAR _StressFloorText =
            [R26 P03 __Stress Floor Explanation]
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                BLANK (),
                SWITCH (
                    TRUE (),
                    _Outcome = "APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED_AUTHORIZED",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The request met the required capacity, resilience, risk, repayment-cost, and economic standards, so no revised terms or additional review were needed."
                            & _MetricsSentence,
                    _Outcome = "COUNTEROFFER_AUTHORIZED",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The original terms did not clear every automatic boundary, so the strategy evaluated "
                            & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _EvaluatedCount, 0 ), "0" )
                            & " governed alternatives."
                            & _ChangeSentence
                            & _MetricsSentence,
                    _Outcome = "COUNTEROFFER_REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The original terms required adjustment, and the strategy evaluated "
                            & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _EvaluatedCount, 0 ), "0" )
                            & " governed alternatives before identifying a review-eligible structure."
                            & _ChangeSentence
                            & _MetricsSentence
                            & " The structure is not yet authorized because "
                            & _ReviewReason
                            & ".",
                    _Outcome = "MANUAL_UNDERWRITING_REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & IF (
                                _SearchAttempted = TRUE (),
                                " The strategy evaluated "
                                    & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _EvaluatedCount, 0 ), "0" )
                                    & " governed alternatives and retained a potentially supportable review path.",
                                " The requested structure remained potentially supportable."
                            )
                            & _MetricsSentence
                            & " Final terms require underwriter review because "
                            & _ReviewReason
                            & ".",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " A reliable structure assessment could not be completed because "
                            & _EvidenceIssue
                            & ". This is an evidence-based stop, not a conclusion that every possible structure would fail.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE"
                        && _StressFloorApplied = TRUE ()
                        && _OutcomeChangedByFloor = TRUE (),
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The independent stress path did not support a more favorable result, and the governed outcome was held to the matched Baseline no-feasible-structure route under the approved non-improvement floor.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The evidence supported a complete assessment, and the strategy tested "
                            & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _EvaluatedCount, 0 ), "0" )
                            & " governed alternatives. None satisfied policy, capacity, resilience, risk, and economics together, so there was no supportable structure to authorize.",
                    _Outcome = "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP",
                        _RequestSentence
                            & " The evidence identified "
                            & _HardStop
                            & ". Because changing the amount, remittance, pricing, or horizon could not cure that condition, the strategy stopped without proposing revised terms.",
                    "The selected application-scenario does not map to a recognized R1 final-decision path."
                )
            )

VAR _Key =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
            )
        VAR _Outcome =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_final_outcome_code]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _EvaluatedCount =
            SELECTEDVALUE (
                'R1DimApplicationScenario'[evaluated_candidate_count]
            )
        VAR _SelectedAmount =
            CALCULATE (
                SELECTEDVALUE (
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[governed_selected_funding_amount]
                ),
                TREATAS (
                    { _Key },
                    'R1FactFinalDecision'[ApplicationScenarioKey]
                )
            )
        VAR _FundingDate =
            [R26 P03 __Physical Funding Date]
        VAR _FundingClause =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _FundingDate ),
                " The account was funded on "
                    & FORMAT ( _FundingDate, "mmmm d, yyyy" )
                    & ".",
                ""
            )
        VAR _EvidenceIssue =
            [R26 P03 __Evidence Issue Plain English]
        VAR _ReviewReason =
            [R26 P03 __Review Reason Plain English]
        VAR _ReviewReasonSentence =
            IF (
                NOT ISBLANK ( _ReviewReason ),
                UPPER ( LEFT ( _ReviewReason, 1 ) )
                    & MID ( _ReviewReason, 2, LEN ( _ReviewReason ) ),
                "A governed review condition remains"
            )
        VAR _HardStop =
            [R26 P03 __Hard Stop Plain English]
        VAR _StressFloorText =
            [R26 P03 __Stress Floor Explanation]
        RETURN
            IF (
                ISBLANK ( _Key ),
                BLANK (),
                SWITCH (
                    _Outcome,
                    "APPROVE_AS_REQUESTED_AUTHORIZED",
                        "Approved as requested. The requested terms were supportable based on the merchant's demonstrated capacity and remained within the approved risk, repayment-cost, and economic guardrails."
                            & _FundingClause,
                    "COUNTEROFFER_AUTHORIZED",
                        "Counteroffer authorized. The selected "
                            & FORMAT ( _SelectedAmount, "$#,0" )
                            & " alternative preserved access to capital while bringing the structure within the merchant's demonstrated capacity and the approved risk and economic guardrails."
                            & _FundingClause,
                    "COUNTEROFFER_REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                        "Counteroffer review required. A potentially supportable "
                            & FORMAT ( _SelectedAmount, "$#,0" )
                            & " alternative was identified. "
                            & _ReviewReasonSentence
                            & ", so specialist review is required before terms can be authorized. No funding has occurred.",
                    "MANUAL_UNDERWRITING_REVIEW_REQUIRED",
                        "Underwriter review required. The request remains potentially supportable. "
                            & _ReviewReasonSentence
                            & ". No funding has occurred.",
                    "DECLINE_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
                        "Declined because required evidence was unavailable. "
                            & UPPER ( LEFT ( _EvidenceIssue, 1 ) )
                            & MID ( _EvidenceIssue, 2, LEN ( _EvidenceIssue ) )
                            & ", so the platform could not establish a sufficiently reliable view of the merchant's operating position. No structure or funding decision was inferred from incomplete data.",
                    "DECLINE_NO_FEASIBLE_STRUCTURE",
                        "Declined because no feasible structure was found. "
                            & IF (
                                COALESCE ( _EvaluatedCount, 0 ) > 0,
                                "A complete search of "
                                    & FORMAT ( _EvaluatedCount, "0" )
                                    & " governed alternatives found no option that met policy, capacity, and economics together.",
                                "The governed route did not support a structure that met policy, capacity, and economics together."
                            )
                            & _StressFloorText
                            & " No funding has occurred.",
                    "DECLINE_POLICY_HARD_STOP",
                        "Declined because of a policy hard stop. The evidence identified "
                            & _HardStop
                            & "; changing the amount, remittance, pricing, or horizon could not cure the condition. No funding has occurred.",
                    "The selected application-scenario does not map to a recognized R1 final-decision path."
                )
            )

VAR _MonitoringDate =
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_date] )
        RETURN
            IF (
                [R26 P03 Funded Lifecycle Available] = 1
                    && NOT ISBLANK ( _MonitoringDate ),
                CALCULATE (
                    [R1 P01 __Cumulative Expected As Of],
                    REMOVEFILTERS ( 'DimAsOfDate' ),
                    TREATAS (
                        { _MonitoringDate },
                        'DimAsOfDate'[AsOfDate]
                    )
                )
            )

measure_name: R26 P03 Primary Alert Family Display
expression:
VAR _Status =
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[monitoring_status_code] )
        VAR _Family =
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[primary_operational_alert_family_code] )
        VAR _StressFloor =
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[stress_status_floor_applied_flag] )
        VAR _RawConditions =
            [R26 P03 Raw Alert Conditions]
        RETURN
            SWITCH (
                TRUE (),
                ISBLANK ( _Status ), BLANK (),
                _Status = "PAID_OFF", "Paid off",
                _StressFloor = "t" && _Family = "NONE", "Stress status floor",
                _Family = "PACE", "Pace",
                _Family = "LIQUIDITY", "Liquidity",
                _Family = "HORIZON", "Horizon overrun",
                _Family = "SALES_DORMANCY", "Sales dormancy / no remittance",
                _Family = "NONE" && COALESCE ( _RawConditions, 0 ) > 0, "Raw condition only",
                _Family = "NONE", "None",
                _Family
            )

measure_name: R26 P03 Daily Shortfall Alert Display
expression:
SWITCH (
            SELECTEDVALUE ( 'R1FactDailyMonitoring'[daily_shortfall_alert_flag] ),
            "t", "Active",
            "f", "Not active",
            BLANK ()

VAR _Key =
